Associate Product Manager Intern
Lumen Health

Lumen builds scheduling software for outpatient clinics. As an APM intern you
will work on one problem area with a senior PM and ship at least one feature.

You will
- Interview clinic staff and synthesise what you hear into problem statements
- Write product requirement documents and acceptance criteria
- Work with engineering and design through delivery
- Define and track success metrics for what you ship
- Run competitive analysis

Required
- Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline
- Excellent written communication — this role is mostly writing
- Comfort with data: you must be able to pull your own numbers in SQL or a BI tool
- Demonstrated ownership of a project from idea through delivery
- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills

Preferred
- Previous internship in product, consulting, or a startup
- Familiarity with healthcare workflows
- Basic understanding of how software is built
- Experience with Figma, Jira or Amplitude
